observations: Black motorcycle helmet with multiple stickers on the front and sides.
Interior lining is grey fabric with a red chin strap.
The helmet shows significant wear and tear on the surface, including scratches and scuffs.
The interior appears to be in good condition.
No brand logos or model numbers are visible on the exterior in the photos.

claims.evidence: Conductivity cannot be tested from a photo; it is a functional claim.
Requires a video of the helmet being worn or a photo of the purchase receipt.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The helmet may have hidden cracks or structural damage not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the helmet being spun or a close-up photo of the underside and seams.

risks.risk: The chin strap may be broken or the buckle may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the chin strap attached to the helmet.

risks.risk: The interior lining may be torn or the foam padding may be degraded.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior with the helmet lying flat.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the interior of the helmet with the chin strap attached.
Video of the helmet being worn to check for cracks and fit.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
